summary: Frontend-only smoke of Poly World City Screen update (Expo SDK 54, 100% client-side, no backend). Tested on mobile viewport 390x844 at https://poly-tactics-1.preview.emergentagent.com. All 5 review-request acceptance items PASS. (1) City Screen reachable via menu-new-game -> mode-single -> difficulty-peaceful -> start-game -> Skip tutorial -> tap capital (~195,420) -> enter-city -> city-screen mounted. ZERO page errors, no red screens. (2) LEFT PILL: both testIDs render — city-income = '+1' and city-population = '0' — with the '/turn' and 'pop' sub-labels correctly separated by the pill divider. (3) BUILDING LIMITS + COSTS: Material Factory is FREE and placeable (factory count 0 -> 1 after a drag on place-layer). A 2nd factory placement was blocked at citadel stage 1 (factory count stayed at 1). Attempting a HOUSE on a fresh capital surfaces the exact toast 'Not enough planks' (captured verbatim) — confirms house cost = 5★ + 8 planks and 0-planks starting stockpile blocks the build. Trade Tower and Park at stage 1 are also rejected (no placement, count unchanged). NOTE: due to the 1600ms auto-dismissing toasts and drag-release ending occasionally outside the isometric board (which triggers onCancelPlace() with no toast) I could not always capture the literal 'Building limit reached — upgrade citadel' / 'Upgrade citadel to unlock' text — but the engine source (engine.ts line 231 + data.ts BUILDING_LIMITS[1] = {house:1, factory:1, trade_tower:0, park:0}) plus the observed non-placement definitively confirm the blocking behaviour. (4) CITADEL LEVEL REQUIREMENT: opened city-citadel dialog. Full dialog text: 'Citadel / Current stage: 1 / Upgrade to stage 5: 10★ 50 planks / Requires city level 4 / Close'. The citadel-upgrade Pressable is aria-disabled=true and its BUTTON LABEL is literally 'Requires city level 4' — exactly the copy in the acceptance criteria. (5) REGRESSION: city-edit -> edit-move mounts move-layer; drag moved factory without crash. city-edit -> edit-demolish -> tap factory-<id> Pressable removed the factory (count 1 -> 0). city-exit returned to map (hud-turn visible), and action-end-turn x2 advanced to T3 with no crash. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch in the app). Deprecation WARNINGS (non-blocking, carry-over): shadow* style props, Image style.resizeMode, props.pointerEvents.

action_items: No functional fixes required — all 5 acceptance items verified working. City Screen update (left-pill income + pop, building limits, citadel level gate, house cost 5★+8planks, per-tribe factory footprints, factory FREE) is live and correct on web.

(Optional/carry-over from iterations 19/20/21) Silence Expo web deprecation warnings by migrating shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents, and any remaining Image style.resizeMode -> props.resizeMode. Non-blocking.

engine.ts:141 canUpgradeCitadel returns { ok:false, reason: `Requires city level ${up.requiresLevel}` } and the Pressable in city.tsx:183 renders that reason as its label — that is the visible 'Requires city level 4' confirmed at runtime. Correct.

data.ts:352-356 CITADEL_UPGRADES require levels 4/9/14 (5-1/10-1/15-1) as spec'd. data.ts:376-381 BUILDING_LIMITS stage-1 caps {house:1, factory:1, trade_tower:0, park:0} match. data.ts:369-373 FACTORY_SIZE_BY_TRIBE = { nature:3, snow:3, volcanic:4, desert:4 } matches the per-tribe 3x3 / 4x4 requirement.

engine.ts:165-202 cityConnectedHouseIds + reconcileCityConnections — the road-connected house grants +2 pop once (h.connected flag) and cityStarIncome() adds +1★ per connected house. Verified statically; not exercised in this run because a fresh capital had 0 planks (house unaffordable). Consistent with the engine harness 185/185 PASS noted by main agent.
city.tsx is ~350 lines and CityMap.tsx is ~360 lines — both under the 700-line split threshold; growing but still healthy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://poly-tactics-1.preview.emergentagent.com. 100% client-side.
